items.title: Alvin "Red" Tyler Interview, 1996-06-19
items.q: we got in touch, uh, with Sam Cook and he said he would open up a little studio for us to rehearse artists that he would bring in and he would give us all fifty dollars a week while we were staying there.

ctx.x: What, what they were thinking was, stay, get out there. Stay, set up the business out there. Yeah.

Okay. So, when we got out there and they said, well, look, man, this is where the opportunity is, even though we couldn't work a regular gig out in California because they had strict rules out there that you, for a year, you had to go to the union every week or whatever and, uh, check in that you haven't left town and that after a year you could take a regular job in the club. Oh, okay. You could only do spot jobs. Right. Okay. So, it was getting kinda funny so, uh, we got in touch, uh, with Sam Cook and he said…
